title: FizzBuzz Lite
statement:
Traffic lights choose an action from a color. Here, choose a word from a number.
Write a function that takes an integer n and returns:
- "Fizz" if n is divisible by 3
- "Buzz" if n is divisible by 5
- "FizzBuzz" if n is divisible by both 3 and 5
- the number as a string otherwise
Examples: 3 → "Fizz", 5 → "Buzz", 15 → "FizzBuzz", 7 → "7".
hints: Check the both-3-and-5 case first, or you may miss it.
Use remainder: n % 3 == 0 means divisible by 3.
Return a string in every branch.

solution.approach: If divisible by 15 (or by 3 and 5), return FizzBuzz. Else if by 3, Fizz. Else if by 5, Buzz. Else return str(n).
solution.complexity: Fixed tiny work per number — a few checks.

analogy: choosing an action from a traffic light color
